items.title: Omer Simeon Interview, 1955-08-18
items.q: But with all of us, the Red Hot Peppers, we got along very good with him.

ctx.x: Was he easy to get along with, personally? Well, with us he was.
Yeah, we got along with him nicely. But with outsiders probably arguments would come up. But with all of us, the Red Hot Peppers, we got along very good with him.
The musicians that he understood and that he was trying to do. Yeah, that's right.
